_meta.purpose: Centralized official rule database — ALL rules must cite official ECI sources
_meta.legalNotice: This database contains rules sourced exclusively from publicly available Election Commission of India resources. Every rule entry must carry a sourceUrl, sourceDocument, and lastVerified timestamp. Rules without verified official sources must NOT be displayed to citizens.
_meta.misinformationPolicy: If any rule cannot be traced to an official ECI source, it must be marked as verified:false and must display the unverified notice to citizens.
_meta.disclaimer: This platform is a public awareness initiative. Information is sourced from publicly available Election Commission resources. Users should verify critical information through official Election Commission channels before taking action. This platform does not determine eligibility, citizenship, or legal status.

citizenCategories.title: Born before 01 July 1987
citizenCategories.subtitle: Citizenship by Birth — Before Amendment
citizenCategories.source: Citizenship Act, 1955 — Section 3(1)(a) as amended by Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 1986
citizenCategories.sourceDocument: Citizenship Act, 1955 — Ministry of Home Affairs
citizenCategories.officialReferenceBody: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
citizenCategories.relevanceNote: Persons born in India before 01 July 1987 are citizens of India by birth, irrespective of the nationality of parents. For SIR voter verification in states conducting NRC-linked rolls, this category determines required documentary evidence.
citizenCategories.applicabilityNote: This category is specifically relevant to electoral roll verification exercises that include citizenship documentation. For standard ECI voter registration, eligibility is determined by being a citizen of India aged 18+ and ordinarily resident. Verify with your local ERO for state-specific requirements.
citizenCategories.voterRegistrationNote: For standard voter registration: Any citizen of India aged 18 years or above who is ordinarily resident in the constituency is eligible. Visit voters.eci.gov.in.

citizenCategories.title: Born between 01 July 1987 and 02 December 2004
citizenCategories.subtitle: Citizenship by Birth — Post-1986 Amendment
citizenCategories.source: Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 1986 — Section 3(1)(b) and Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2003
citizenCategories.sourceDocument: Citizenship Act, 1955 (as amended up to 2004) — Ministry of Home Affairs
citizenCategories.officialReferenceBody: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
citizenCategories.relevanceNote: Persons born in India between 01 July 1987 and 02 December 2004 are citizens by birth if either parent was a citizen of India at the time of birth. Documentary evidence of parent's citizenship may be required in certain state-level SIR contexts.
citizenCategories.applicabilityNote: This category is relevant where electoral roll verification requires citizenship documentation. For standard voter registration, eligibility is determined by ECI rules. Verify with your local ERO for state-specific requirements.
citizenCategories.voterRegistrationNote: For voter registration, visit voters.eci.gov.in or contact Voter Helpline 1950.

citizenCategories.title: Born after 02 December 2004
citizenCategories.subtitle: Citizenship by Birth — Post-2003 Amendment
citizenCategories.sourceDocument: Citizenship Act, 1955 (as amended by Citizenship Amendment Act, 2003) — Ministry of Home Affairs
citizenCategories.officialReferenceBody: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
citizenCategories.relevanceNote: Persons born in India after 02 December 2004 are citizens by birth only if both parents are citizens of India, or one parent is a citizen and the other is not an illegal migrant. Both parents' citizenship documentation may be required.
citizenCategories.applicabilityNote: This category is relevant where electoral roll verification requires citizenship documentation. For standard voter registration, eligibility is determined by ECI rules. Verify with your local ERO for state-specific requirements.
citizenCategories.voterRegistrationNote: For voter registration, visit voters.eci.gov.in or contact Voter Helpline 1950.
citizenCategories.displayWarning: Please verify the exact documentary requirements for your state with your local Electoral Registration Officer (ERO) or by calling Voter Helpline 1950.

parentsCitizenship.label: Parent's Citizenship Proof (for Category B)
parentsCitizenship.sourceDocument: Citizenship Act, 1955 (as amended 1986) — Ministry of Home Affairs
parentsCitizenship.note: At least one parent must be a citizen of India. Specific requirements vary by state. Verify with local ERO.

bothParentsCitizenship.sourceDocument: Citizenship Act, 1955 (as amended 2003) — Ministry of Home Affairs
bothParentsCitizenship.note: Both parents must be Indian citizens OR one parent citizen and other not an illegal migrant. Specific requirements vary by state. Verify with local ERO.

voterRegistrationRules.title: Basic Voter Registration Eligibility
voterRegistrationRules.rule: A person is entitled to be registered as a voter if: (a) they are a citizen of India, (b) they have attained the age of 18 years on the qualifying date, (c) they are ordinarily resident in the constituency.
voterRegistrationRules.source: Representation of the People Act, 1950 — Section 19
voterRegistrationRules.note: The qualifying date is January 1 of the year of revision, unless otherwise notified by ECI.

voterRegistrationRules.title: Disqualification from Voter Registration
voterRegistrationRules.rule: A person is disqualified from registration if: (a) they are not a citizen of India, (b) they are of unsound mind declared by a competent court, (c) they are for the time being disqualified under the provisions of any law relating to corrupt practices.
voterRegistrationRules.source: Representation of the People Act, 1950 — Section 16

voterRegistrationRules.title: Ordinary Residence Definition
voterRegistrationRules.rule: A person is ordinarily resident in a constituency if they normally reside there. Temporary absence does not break ordinary residence. A student studying away from home may register at either their home or study address.
voterRegistrationRules.source: Representation of the People Act, 1950 — Section 20 and ECI Instructions
voterRegistrationRules.note: Verify current ECI instructions at eci.gov.in as they may be updated.
